'''2010 US West Nationals Day 2 Joe Olson DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
